title: 第1710章 黑市押注第1709章 五重大罗金仙境
lines: 飞船。
黑市。
这里有着斗武场。
武者互相厮杀，或者是武者和妖兽厮杀，都可以所以下注。
黑天最喜欢赌博，毕竟这种下注很是刺激。
“林兄弟，你终于来了，赶快下注，这可是以弱博强，你看看这个女子，要和金毛狮厮杀，不过肯定会第一回合便被彻底撕碎。”
巨大的八角笼内。
一个身材纤细的女子，满脸坚韧的看着面前比自己高大很多的金毛狮，眼神里没有流露出丝毫的惧意。
四周的人群激情的咆哮着，一个个满脸激动的看着八角笼，疯狂的呐喊着。
“在哪里下注。”
“你要下多少，我给帮你去下注。”
林铮拿出一张仙石卡，说道：“将里面的仙石全部下注。”
“好，我帮你下金毛狮赢。”
林铮却是摇摇头，说道：“我押小女孩赢。”
“林兄弟，你是不是搞错了，很明显这个小女孩不可能赢，你看看金毛狮，可是巅峰银仙境，而小女孩只是刚刚突破到银仙境修为，两者之间的境界差距实在太大了。”
黑天实在想不通，林铮到底是怎么回事，为什么非要押小女孩赢，完全是不可能的事情，这和白白送给人家仙石有什么区别。
“帮我压。”
黑天原本还想说什么，只是看着林铮脸上的表情，他本身很清楚林铮的性格，但凡决定的事情，几乎很难改变。
显得很是无奈，黑天立刻去压住。
“你看好小女孩？”
“那我也去下注。”
轻灵选择相信林铮，不一会的时间，轻灵和黑天则是走了回来，将凭证给了林铮，说道：“林兄弟，你相信我，小女孩肯定不是金毛狮的敌手。”
刚刚说完，金毛狮已经率先向小女孩发起了进攻，一波接着一波，攻势很是强烈。
热浪般的呐喊和嘶吼，响彻整个斗武场。
“林兄弟，你看看你压住的小女孩，甚至连还手的机会都没有。”
林铮只是笑笑不已，毕竟自己下注整张仙石卡，要是胜出的话，自己这次算是赚大发了。
就在此时。
整个斗武场瞬间鸦雀无声，因为金毛狮已经倒地不起，小女孩身上却是多了几道血口子。
“够狠！”
轻灵唏嘘道：“以自身为诱饵，引金毛狮露出破绽，一招毙命，真的是够狠，不仅对敌人狠，更是对自己也狠。”
似乎想到了什么，黑天满脸震惊的说道：“这绝对是大冷门，林兄弟，你这次赢了十倍的仙石。”
刚刚下注的时候，他当然知道林铮给她的仙石卡内，到底有多少的仙石，十倍的价格，想想都知道有多少。
content_en:
spaceship.
black market.
There is a fighting arena here.
You can bet on warriors fighting each other, or warriors fighting monsters.
Krishna liked gambling the most, after all, this kind of betting was very exciting.
"Brother Lin, you are finally here. Hurry up and place your bet. This is a battle of weakness and strength. Look at this woman. She is going to fight a golden lion, but she will definitely be completely torn apart in the first round."
Inside the huge octagonal cage.
A slender woman looked at the golden lion who was much taller than herself with a stoic face, without showing the slightest fear in her eyes.
The crowd around them roared passionately, looking at the Octagon with excited faces and shouting crazily.
"Where to place your bets."
"How much do you want to bet? I'll help you place the bet."
Lin Zheng took out a fairy stone card and said: "Bet all the fairy stones in it."
"Okay, I'll help you win by playing Golden Retriever Lion."
Lin Zheng shook his head and said, "I bet on the little girl to win."
"Brother Lin, are you mistaken? It is obvious that this little girl cannot win. Look at the golden lion, which is at the peak of the Silver Fairyland, and the little girl has just broken through to the Silver Fairyland. The gap between the two realms is really too big."
Heitian really couldn't figure out what was going on with Lin Zheng and why he had to bet on the little girl to win. It was completely impossible. What was the difference between this and giving someone a fairy stone for free.
"Help me press it."
Heitian originally wanted to say something, but he just looked at the expression on Lin Zheng's face. He knew Lin Zheng's character very well, and it was almost difficult to change anything he decided.
Seemingly helpless, Heitian immediately suppressed him.
"Do you like the little girl?"
"Yes."
"Then I'll place a bet too."
Qing Ling chose to believe in Lin Zheng. After a while, Qing Ling and Heitian came back, gave the certificate to Lin Zheng, and said, "Brother Lin, believe me, the little girl is definitely no match for the Golden Retriever Lion."
Just after finishing speaking, the golden retriever lion took the lead in launching an attack on the little girl. One wave after another, the offensive was very strong.
Heat-wave-like shouts and roars resounded throughout the fighting arena.
"Brother Lin, look at the little girl you're holding down. She doesn't even have a chance to fight back."
Lin Zheng just smiled. After all, he bet on the entire fairy stone card. If he wins, he will make a lot of money this time.
Right now.
The entire fighting arena was silent for an instant, because the golden-haired lion had fallen to the ground, but the little girl had a few bloody wounds on her body.
"Hard enough!"
Qing Ling lamented: "Using myself as bait, the golden haired lion showed its flaws and killed it with one move. It is really cruel, not only to the enemy, but also to itself."
Seemingly thinking of something, Heitian said with a shocked face: "This is definitely a big upset, Brother Lin, you won ten times the immortal stones this time."
When he just placed the bet, of course he knew how many immortal stones there were in the immortal stone card that Lin Zheng gave her. At ten times the price, he knew how much there was just thinking about it.
